pages.title: Classic Round Christmas Ornament Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a classic round Christmas ornament with a fluted cap, a circular hanging loop, and two curved lines near the base.

pages.title: Easy Christmas Ornament with Wide Stripes Coloring Page
pages.description: Broad curved stripes divide the round Christmas ornament on this printable coloring page into large sections beneath a scalloped cap and a hanging loop.

pages.title: Blank Christmas Ornament Outline Coloring Page
pages.description: A round Christmas ornament with a scalloped cap and a circular hanging loop leaves a blank center for drawing your own pattern on this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Christmas Ornament Cutouts Coloring Page
pages.description: Four Christmas ornament cutouts on this printable coloring page include a round bauble, teardrop, star, and heart, each with its own small hanging loop.

pages.title: Christmas Ornament with a Ribbon Bow Coloring Page
pages.description: A large ribbon bow with pointed tails tops the round Christmas ornament on this printable coloring page, above wavy bands framing a row of stars.

pages.title: Christmas Bauble with a Snowflake Pattern Coloring Page
pages.description: A large six-armed snowflake fills the round Christmas bauble on this printable coloring page, with a scalloped cap and a teardrop-shaped hanging loop above.

pages.title: Christmas Ornament with Stars Coloring Page
pages.description: A large central star and five smaller stars decorate the round bauble on this printable coloring page, with a scalloped cap above the pattern.

pages.title: Striped Teardrop Christmas Ornament Coloring Page
pages.description: Curved stripes wrap around the teardrop Christmas ornament on this printable coloring page, flowing from the scalloped cap toward the tapered point at the bottom.

pages.title: Star Christmas Ornament Coloring Page
pages.description: A smaller five-pointed star sits inside the broad star-shaped Christmas ornament on this printable coloring page, topped by a scalloped cap and a simple hanging loop.

pages.title: Christmas Bell Ornament with Holly Coloring Page
pages.description: A cluster of holly leaves and berries sits above the flared Christmas bell on this printable coloring page, with a round clapper visible below the rim.

pages.title: Heart Christmas Ornament with Polka Dots Coloring Page
pages.description: Large polka dots fill the heart-shaped Christmas ornament on this printable coloring page, with a fluted cap and a circular hanging loop above the heart.

pages.title: Wooden Snowflake Christmas Ornament Coloring Page
pages.description: Overlapping slats form the six branches of a wooden snowflake Christmas ornament on this printable coloring page, with a loop threaded through a small ring.

pages.title: Candy Cane Christmas Ornament Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a candy cane Christmas ornament with diagonal stripes around its hook and stem, a ribbon bow, and a long hanging loop.

pages.title: Christmas Stocking Ornament Coloring Page
pages.description: A large star decorates the cuffed Christmas stocking ornament on this printable coloring page, with rounded patches outlining the toe and heel at the bottom.

pages.title: Santa Face Christmas Ornament Coloring Page
pages.description: Santa’s face forms the Christmas ornament on this printable coloring page, with a pom-pom hat, a curled mustache, and a full beard beneath his smile.

pages.title: Snowman Christmas Ornament with a Top Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: A snowman ornament wears a holly-trimmed top hat and striped scarf, with a carrot nose and a hanging loop on this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Reindeer Face Christmas Ornament Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a reindeer face ornament with rounded antlers, a broad smiling muzzle, and a hanging loop centered between the antlers.

pages.title: Gingerbread Man Christmas Ornament Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling gingerbread man wears a bow tie and three round buttons, with wavy icing along his arms and legs on this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Christmas Pickle Ornament Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling Christmas pickle ornament has a curved shape, small bumps, and a round hanging loop above its scalloped cap in this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Pinecone Christmas Ornament Coloring Page
pages.description: Overlapping rows of rounded scales form this pinecone Christmas ornament, with a tall teardrop-shaped loop attached to its cap in this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Vintage Glass Christmas Ornament Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features an elongated vintage glass ornament with two leafy bands and a ribbed bulb that tapers to a pointed tip.

pages.title: Christmas Name Ornament with a Blank Banner Coloring Page
pages.description: Three stars and a holly sprig frame a blank banner where you can write a name on this printable coloring page of a Christmas ornament.

pages.title: Christmas Ornaments Hanging at Different Heights Coloring Page
pages.description: Three ornaments hang from bows at different heights on this printable coloring page, with a wavy striped bauble, a pointed finial, and a heart.

pages.title: Christmas Tree with Oversized Baubles Coloring Page
pages.description: Six oversized round baubles hang from the branches of a potted Christmas tree crowned by a five-pointed star on this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Reflector Christmas Ornament on a Pine Branch Coloring Page
pages.description: A reflector ornament with a scalloped starburst and pointed finial hangs from a pine branch with clusters of long needles in this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Christmas Ornament Storage Box Coloring Page
pages.description: An open storage box holds six baubles in separate compartments, with a star, stripes, and other patterns to color on this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Christmas Ornament with a Snowy Village Inside Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page frames three snow-covered cottages, a winding path, and evergreen trees inside a round Christmas ornament topped with a ribbon bow.

pages.title: Christmas Wreath with Round Ornaments Coloring Page
pages.description: Five patterned baubles decorate an evergreen wreath topped with a large ribbon bow, including ornaments with a star and a snowflake on this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Detailed Christmas Ornament with Filigree Coloring Page
pages.description: A round Christmas ornament pairs a ribbon bow with symmetrical filigree scrolls and flower petals around a circular center in this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Christmas Bauble with a Mandala Pattern Coloring Page
pages.description: A round Christmas bauble contains a floral mandala with pointed petals and rounded scallops radiating from a central circle in this printable coloring page.
